title: Query current CRM people
intent: Read people currently visible to the signed-in Twenty user.
instructions: Call query_people for current workspace data; do not answer from Skill text or stale page content.
Use name_contains only when the user supplied a person-name filter.
To open the People collection, call query_people once, then call goto with /objects/people, the collection route authorized by that ToolResult.
To open one person, require exactly one API match and call goto with that result's exact ui_path.
After goto, observe the target record before reporting completion.
For zero or multiple matches, ask for clarification rather than inventing a route.
